There is an ongoing controversy regarding intellectual property (IP) laws and whether they truly operate to confer the stated public benefits. This debate questions whether the protection they are said to provide is appropriate in the context of innovation derived from traditional knowledge and folklore, and patents for software and business methods. Manifestations of this controversy can be seen in the way different jurisdictions interpret and enforce IP laws.
